sara: Quick ask — need approval to create a new GCP project (redwood-inference-asia-burst) and raise GPU quota in asia-east1 for production inference. Target: 12 x H100 (p4d-like), 24 x L4, plus 6 spare instances for failover. Need static egress IPs for NAT and VPC peering. Cost estimate ~ $45k/mo. @mike can you own the support case?

mike: Got it. Two quick questions: 1) billing account ID and project number? 2) Which exact zones (a/b/c)? Also need business justification phrase for the GCP form (short). Any hard latency requirements?

raj: For the quota request, call it "inference: low-latency serving (reserved capacity)". Add scaling plan: start with 6 nodes, scale to 12 H100 and 24 L4 over 2 months. Request preemptible fallback? probably not for critical paths. Include expected token/sec and peak qps.

lina: Also flag networking: request increase to regional external addresses and 1000 concurrent connections in the firewall NAT policy. If you want cross-region fallback, ask for egress quota on us-west1 as well.

sara: Billing: 0123-4567-890. Project number: 987654321. Zones: asia-east1-a,b. Justification: "Customer-facing inference service — low-latency generative API for paying customers; predictable reserved capacity required for SLOs and model rollouts." Latency SLO: p95 < 200ms for short-context workloads.

mike: Filing now. I will open a GCP support case and attach the forecast sheet. Filing notes: project=987654321, billing=0123-4567-890, quotas: H100=12, L4=24, regional external IPs=8, vpc-peering routes=50. Adding note about autoscaler and fallback variants.

mike: (code) ```
# quick checks before filing
gcloud compute regions describe asia-east1 --project=987654321
gcloud compute addresses create inference-eip-1 --region=asia-east1 --project=987654321
```

raj: Make sure the service account used to talk to GCP support has roles/compute.admin and roles/compute.networkAdmin. Also include the roster of owners in the ticket so they can ask followups: sara, mike, raj.

lina: Heads-up on costs: if GPUs run full-time this will spike to ~ $55-60k/mo with sustained usage. Can we limit daytime hours for non-critical workloads? Tag nodes with cost-center=redwood-inference to track.

mike: Noted. We'll add a schedule for non-prod burst pools and enforce labels. I'll put an alert if spend > $48k/mo.
